ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) distribution with a macro-level white-to-black pixel ratio of approximately 0.10:0.90 across the fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe features isolated dark focal spots at mid-inner coordinates; right lobe exhibits a series of vertical dark bands located between the mid-point and the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge, characterized by pixel-amplitude spikes of 3-5px and deep irregular valleys at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature fitted to both lobes, tapering from the median notch toward the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular low-intensity clusters (black on dark grey) visible in the lower-central region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of 3-4 parallel vertical dark pixel lines (rake marks) crossing the right lobe surface perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical rake marks on the right lobe and significant irregular erosion/jagged contours at the terminal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe displays a significantly higher density of linear scarring compared to the left lobe.
